_comment: Managed mode, aggregated serving: prefill.replicas 0 disables the prefill role entirely and all traffic goes to decode pods. teardown false leaves the releases running so several benchmarks can be run against one standup — remember to 'helm uninstall' them yourself.

llm_d._comment_extra: Escape hatch for any chart value madengine does not model. Deep-merged last, so it wins.
